parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The application ID. The application ID is the value of the `AppId` parameter returned by the [CreateAppInfo](~~CreateAppInfo~~) or [ListAppInfo](~~ListAppInfo~~) operation.

parameters.name: StorageLocation
parameters.description: The OSS bucket address. This parameter is required when StorageType is set to user_oss_bucket.

parameters.name: StorageType
parameters.description:
The storage type. Valid values:

- vod_oss_bucket
- user_oss_bucket

Default value: **vod_oss_bucket**.
